about: How alike two channel names are, from 0 to 1.
notes: Scores are compared to four decimal places. Two languages doing the same arithmetic agree to far more places than anyone needs, but not necessarily to all of them.
0.82 and above is applied without asking. Note that a regional variant scores 0.95 here: the score alone is not enough to switch channel on, which is why names.same exists beside it.

cases.name: a quality word makes no difference
a regional variant still scores high
cases.why: Recorded because it is the trap: 0.95 is well above the accept threshold, and acting on this score alone would silently switch someone to another country's feed.

cases.name: a country prefix costs a little
a different number scores nothing at all
cases.why: The digit rule, and the reason it is absolute: `Alto Sports 2` and `Alto Sports 4` differ by one character and share every other word.

cases.name: a singular and a plural are close but not equal
one word in common out of two
